_om: Skravla in English (Chatterbox, rusj.no/en/chatterbox/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. «Forklar ordet» is ‘explain the word’: one player explains, the rest of the team guesses, and every correct word moves the team's token along the track («løypa») towards the finish («mål»). «Forbudte ord» is the mode with forbidden words under each word. The words come from the English word bank (data/kategorier.en), the forbidden words and the Christmas theme from data.en/. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Easy words – good when the kids are playing.
Lette og middels ord – passer for de fle: Easy and medium words – right for most groups.
Middels og vanskelige ord – for dere som: Medium and hard words – for word lovers.
Tiden er ute! Siste ord: alle lag kan gj: Time's up! Last word: every team can guess.
Nå kan alle lag gjette! Hvem tok det?: Now every team can guess! Who got it?
Well done! Now let's check the words.
Ordet er skjult. Fortsett når {lag} er k: The word is hidden. Continue when {lag} are ready.
«Forbudte ord» har bare {antall} her, og: ‘Forbidden words’ only has {antall} here and needs at least {min}. {hva}.

{n} ord med forbudte ord på nivå {niva}..one: {n} word with forbidden words at {niva} level.
{n} ord med forbudte ord på nivå {niva}..other: {n} words with forbidden words at {niva} level.

Beste runde: {rekord} – ny rekord! Klare: Best round: {rekord} – a new record! Can you beat it?
Beste runde: {rekord}. Klarer dere flere: Best round: {rekord}. Can you beat it?
Lag mot lag: én forklarer, resten av lag: Team against team: one player explains, the rest of the team guesses. Every correct word moves your token one space closer to the finish.
Få laget ditt til å si ordet på skjermen: Get your team to say the word on the screen – without saying the word itself or any part of it.
Trykk «Riktig ✓» når laget gjetter ordet: Tap ‘Correct ✓’ when your team guesses the word, or ‘Skip’. You can also swipe the card: right is correct, left is skip.
Når tiden er ute, retter dere feil og fl: When time's up, fix any mistakes and move the token. First to the finish wins – but every team gets the same number of rounds.
Siste ord når tiden er ute: alle lag kan: The last word when time runs out: every team can guess. The team that gets it scores the point.
Ikke lov: peke på ting, rime, si ordet p: Not allowed: pointing at things, rhyming, saying the word in another language or ‘it starts with …’.
Forbudte ord: under ordet står ordene al: Forbidden words: under the word are the words everyone would say first. They are forbidden, in every form. An opponent watches over the explainer's shoulder and taps ‘Forbidden word!’ when one slips out – then the word is lost, and so is a point.
Trykket noen feil? Rett det i lista ette: Someone tapped the wrong one? Fix it in the list after the round.
Bytt forklarer hver runde, så alle får p: Take turns explaining, so everyone gets a go.
Explain the word – without saying it.
First team to the finish wins.
Hvordan spiller dere?: How do you want to play?
Forklar ordet med egne ord: Explain the word in your own words
De opplagte ordene er forbudt: The obvious words are off limits
Del dere i lag som sitter sammen. Én for: Split into teams that sit together. One explains, the rest of the team guesses.
Only words from the theme. The categories take a break.
For those who like it tough.
A tie at the top! One more round.
Every team gets the same number of turns.
Den som forklarer, tar mobilen. En motst: Whoever explains takes the phone. An opponent keeps an eye on the forbidden words.
Den som forklarer, tar mobilen. Resten a: Whoever explains takes the phone. The rest of the team guesses.
Forbudt ord sagt: minus ett poeng: Forbidden word said: minus one point
No words were explained this round.

{p} poeng – {margin} foran nærmeste lag..one: {p} point – {margin} ahead of the next team.
{p} poeng – {margin} foran nærmeste lag..other: {p} points – {margin} ahead of the next team.

Beste runde: {lag} med {n} ord – ny reko.other: Best round: {lag} with {n} words – a new {tid} s record!

Beste runde: {lag} med {n} ord. Rekorden.one: Best round: {lag} with {n} word. The {tid} s record is {rekord}.
Beste runde: {lag} med {n} ord. Rekorden.other: Best round: {lag} with {n} words. The {tid} s record is {rekord}.

Ordene i denne runden teller ikke. Laget: The words in this round won't count. The team can start the round again.
Runden som pågår, teller ikke. Laget som: The round in progress won't count. The team in the lead wins.
The team in the lead now wins.
